P23-12.name: Siegwurm-SixFactor
P23-12.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Scarlet Flame"/"Blood Crystal"/"Jade Thunder"/"Silver Zero"/"Golden Cloud"/"Azure Wave" families.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “Petit Glow”/“Petit Bat”/“Petit Lampo”/“Petit Stark”/“Petit Feaniel”/“Petit Shack”, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, either destroy an opposing Nexus, or destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.
